title: Agent harnesses, runtime control, and secure execution
subtitle: Build the environment that runs, limits, observes, and recovers an agent.
goal: Control the environment around an agent
intro: The harness is the application code that lets a model use tools while retaining control of permissions, state, and resources.
terms: The execution environment around the model

flow: Verified result or explicit unresolved state
